Best shooter I've played, and I'm not even that big of an FPS person. This game sold me on movement shooters in general. The movement system is immaculate and allows for an extreme amount of flexibility when playing, as well as allows a ridiculous amount of cool shit to just happen naturally/. Playing as a titan feels great and really scratches the mecha itch. The interplay between pilots and titans is great, as it provides good gameplay variety during matches and gives a real "david vs. goliath" feel when you face a titan as a pilot. It especially helps that pilots can fight titans if they use their environment and superior movement effectively, as it means the odds are stacked against you if you run into a titan but you're never powerless. Overall, game is extremely good and I recommend this to anyone who enjoys shooters even a little bit.

Its a super fun shooter game with smooth combat and cool movement like wall-running and double jumping. The best part is the bond between the pilot, Cooper and his Titan BT, it's surprisingly emotional. The game is short, but it keeps things exciting with cool levels, like one where you mess with time. The Titan battles are fun, but I actually enjoyed the pilot combat more. The story really stands out, especially the emotional bond you build with BT. By the end, when you have to say goodbye, you’ll genuinely feel like you’ve lost a friend. Overall, it’s a great game that’s definitely worth playing.

I only played the single player campaign and truly enjoyed the action and story. It's not too complicated per-se, but there's enough tactics to be had with the pilot and titan interaction. Story is short, took me 7 hours (with the occasional death), and I'm sure many can finish it in 5 hours or even less. But if you're not looking for something that requires a ton of investment and like to play shorter single-player shooters such as CoD for their story and then you put the game aside (and don't bother with multi-player), then it's worth getting especially if on sale (which I heard sometimes approached about five bucks or so). It's quite pretty too, and I had no technical difficulties. Editing the config file even allowed my dual 4K resolution to work at 7680x2160.

Unfortunately it comes with the EA launcher which I uninstalled immediately after finishing, and uninstalling the game. Almost willing to give it a thumbs down because of that.

This is not only one of the best FPS titles i've played in a long time, it's one of the best games. I was caught totally off guard by how much I enjoyed this game. It takes everything that was good about TF1 and expands and fine tunes it. They even added a full single player campaign/story mode that is actually fantastic. Then of course the addictive multiplayer. So easy to jump and start learning, as most if it will feel very familiar to the average FPS player. But the mechanics and features are complex enough that you have room to explore whats possible and really master getting around. It's just so fluid, responsive and reliable. Momentum is your friend here, and so are the various gadgets you can choose from. Like the newly added grappling hook which when used properly in conjunction with jumps and wall runs can propel you across the entire map, if you know what you're doing. Or at least yank yourself out of the way from a stomping Titan coming your way. The guns are all fun to learn and have their own clear strengths and weaknesses. There is a good amount of customization for your pilot and your own Titan, but if I had to ask for one thing it would be more visual customization to our appearance, other than just camo paint jobs. Depending on what class/ability you go with, your pilots gear changes, and then you customize the paint job over that.

Ok, lets see

Singleplayer : One of, if not the best singleplayer experience I've ever played. From level design, chemistry between characters to variety of mission difficulties really bring the campaign to high standards. The developments between BT and Cooper is the major highlight to my point. The way they carve the path from zero to hero kept me on my seat throughout the storylines. My sad disappointment is the campaign didn't last that long that I could finished it in two days. I really wish next installment (if EA barely care enough) will present more in-depth journey in their futuristic interplanetary civilization and more all-out grounded titan warfare like TF2 campaign presented.

Multiplayer : Didn't play it a lot. Most of the time I was just doing nothing in lobby waiting for matchmaking that took forever, leaving me finding an enjoyment watching spinning loading animation. The MP is too dead rn knowing EA has abandoned this masterpiece.

So 8.5/10 i guess. Could have been 9,5/10 if the MP isn't a dry barren

No multiplayer support for base game. Multiplayer is only accessible through modded game client w/ northstar. Hats off to the community that made it happen however even with northstar there is only about 10 servers, some of which have ping upwards of 300+ that completely tear down any enjoyable experience to be gained. So then out of those ten servers strike off another five for connection issues, you're left with a couple glitch and team death match lobbies that are pilot only. So as a result, can't even use a mech in a mech game. This game is a tragedy, do not buy unless ok with pilot combat on one server only. Dont let the positive reviews trick you.
